A woman IAS officer in Tamil Nadu has filed a harassment complaint against Kallakurichi TVK MLA C. Arul Vignesh. The case has raised questions about Chief Minister Vijay's commitment to women's safety and his government's response. In this episode of The Hindu Focus Tamil Nadu, we examine the Madras High Court's intervention and the questions of accountability facing the TVK government.
Thank you for watching our video!
